title: Lemon Pepper Chickpeas
description: Creamy one-pot lemon pepper chickpeas ready in about 20 minutes. Serve over vegetables, pasta, or rice, or sop up with crusty bread. Inspired by lemon pepper wings.

steps.title: Cook in one pot
steps.text: Combine {i01} with remaining ingredients in one pot on the stove and cook until everything comes together, about 20 minutes.

rawText:

Lemon pepper wings, but chickpeas 🍋

New here? I'm Sarah, known by many as the Chickpea Queen. I've got a can of chickpeas and a new idea for it every week.

I'm an nutritionist and since I'm a scientist who creates easy vegetarian recipes and this is the easy dinner I make when I only have 20 minutes everything comes together in one pot on the stove and it packs in so much flavor These are my creamy lemon pepper chickpeas. This is consistently one of the most popular recipes on my website And it has dozens of five star reviews you can serve it over vegetables or pasta or rice or just sop it up with some good crusty bread.
